It's blindingly, and painfully, apparent that we live in an age of spiritual darkness. It is natural and healthy to despise this darkness, to not to sit idle as it consumes us, everyone, and everything around it. My brothers and sisters, my folk, we must also not forget about why we hate this darkness, about what we are fighting for.

We must be a light in this sea of darkness. We must ask ourselves what we truly desire once the dust has settled when the fight is over. Do you want a loving family? Children to raise and carry on your deeds? Friendships filled with trust, memories, and joy? To be apart of something that will bring stability, prosperity, and beauty in this dark age and for ages to come? To see our people reach new heights that will amaze even us? To see our beautiful sacred groves once again across our lands? To know our Gods, our greater kin, are genuinely smiling down upon us?

Do not be mistaken that any of this can not be accomplished in the here and now. We must strive for this today!

We are disfigured from this darkness, and rightfully so we will have our retribution. My kin, we must not forget what we are fighting for, we must not forget what is truly important. We must protect, and nurture, everything that is good in our lives like one would do with their small child. This simple, yet beautiful, ideal will be what keeps us going, what encourages us to make small sacrifices, and what will ultimately awaken our folk-without.

It is nearly Yuletide, and the veil between worlds is thinning. Our ancestors are beginning to walk closer among us once again. I ask of my folk to remember our ancestors, and our Gods. They love us, they want us to achieve happiness, they want us to be safe. Give blot to them, and may they bless you with their presence as we become more immersed in our Folk-Spirit this Yuletide season.

As always, I wish nothing but peace and well-being for all my kin. May all the folk have a happy Yuletide, and achieve great honor in their own right.
